title: Automations with a fixed time don't always start reliably
symptom: Automations with a fixed time (e.g., at 20:00) sometimes do not trigger reliably. The user observes that the background automation queries occur at irregular intervals, sometimes with gaps of several minutes, causing the fixed-time trigger to be missed. This happens about once a week for one of three fixed-time automations.
cause: The user hypothesizes that the background automation queries occur at irregular intervals, and if a fixed-time trigger falls within a longer gap between queries, the automation is missed. The maintainer states that background automation requires Loop enabled and in OPEN/CLOSE/LGS mode, pump connected, and Objective 10 started, but the user confirms these are met.
evidence_quote: The 8:00 PM query exceeded a tolerance, and the start was discarded. I have automations with three fixed times. About once a week, one of them is discarded.
